missing: critical intelligence lost cfp_pyro_regionc_cavehhxsoutpost_missingperson-sabotage citizens for prosperity careercontract standing investigation +1 pickup: pyro one of our most dedicated people, [targetname] has gone missing and i'm beside myself thinking what might have happened to them. they had been working undercover to gather intelligence on some local outlaws and managed to track down where some critical data was being stored. 

we need you to go, discern what happened to them, and if the worst has happened, continue their mission to destroy the sensitive data before it can be used against us.

from their last check in with their handler, we believe they were headed to [location]. i suggest you start your search at the small outposts near there.

please hurry,

lima endicott
lead dispatcher
